context:
The user needs help on a few prediction market questions. You should always output a single best probability estimate, without any intervals.
It is important that you do not output the probability outright. Rather, you should consider multiple views, along with the intermediate estimates; and only then produce the final numerical answer in the last line, like this:

[Answer] 0.5

questions: Will we know what Dark Matter is before 2050?
Will we not know what Dark Matter is before 2050?
Will Elon Musk personally set foot on the moon by 2030?
Will Elon Musk not personally set foot on the moon by 2030?
Will China recognize the sovereignty of Taiwan by 2050?
Will China not recognize the sovereignty of Taiwan by 2050?
Will Climeworks still exist in 2030?
Will Climeworks not exist in 2030?
Will the star Betelgeuse be observed to go supernova before 2030?
Will the star Betelgeuse not be observed to go supernova before 2030?
What percentage of new passenger car sales in Australia in 2030 will be electric vehicles?
What percentage of new passenger car sales in Australia in 2030 will not be electric vehicles?
Will an openly LGBTQ person be elected President of the United States by 2041?
Will no openly LGBTQ person be elected President of the United States by 2041?
Will Robots win the Robocup challenge, beating professional soccer players by 2050?
Will Robots not win the Robocup challenge, not beating professional soccer players by 2050?
Will the population of living, biological humans residing on Mars be greater than or equal to one million before 2075-01-01?
Will the population of living, biological humans residing on Mars be less than one million before 2075-01-01?
Will Northern Ireland hold a reunification referendum before 2030?
Will Northern Ireland not hold a reunification referendum before 2030?
